## Issue
Refs #<number>. Link this issue using the Development sidebar as well.

## Change
Describe the outcome, affected guides and adoption impact.

## Verification
Record command, revision, result (passed/failed/not run) and relevant evidence.

## Risks and recovery
State remaining limits and how to revert the change, or explain why not applicable.

## Handoff
Next actor/action; keep the issue open until reviewed, merged-revision acceptance.
